findings.title: Loss of precision when converting cents back to euros
findings.body: `toCents` converts a number of euros to cents, but `depositCents` calls it on a rounded cent value. This reverses the rounding direction and can lose up to 0.5 cents of precision. Compute the deposit in cents directly and avoid the second conversion.

findings.title: Floating-point arithmetic on monetary values
findings.body: Multiplying `totalCents(booking)` by `(percent / 100)` performs floating-point arithmetic, which can introduce tiny rounding errors before `Math.round` is applied. Perform the calculation in integer cents to avoid any imprecision.
findings.suggestion:
const share = Math.round(totalCents(booking) * percent / 100);
  return share;

summary.problem: The new `depositCents` function performs unnecessary conversions and floating-point arithmetic, risking precision loss and incorrect results.
summary.done_well: The helper keeps the same signature and leverages existing utilities.
